{{short description|German mathematician}}
'''Rudolf Halin''' (February 3, 1934 – November 14, 2014) was a German [[graph theory|graph theorist]], known for defining the [[End (graph theory)|ends]] of infinite graphs,{{sfnp|Halin|1964}} for [[Halin's grid theorem]],{{sfnp|Halin|1965}}<ref>{{citation|last=Diestel|first=Reinhard|title=A short proof of Halin's grid theorem|journal=Abhandlungen aus dem Mathematischen Seminar der Universität Hamburg|volume=74|pages=237–242|year=2004|doi=10.1007/BF02941538|mr=2112834|author-link=Reinhard Diestel|s2cid=124603912}}.</ref> for extending [[Menger's theorem]] to infinite graphs,{{sfnp|Halin|1974}} and for his early research on [[treewidth]] and [[tree decomposition]].{{sfnp|Halin|1976}} He is also the namesake of [[Halin graph]]s, a class of [[planar graph]]s constructed from [[tree (graph theory)|trees]] by adding a cycle through the leaves of the given tree; earlier researchers had studied the subclass of [[cubic graph|cubic]] Halin graphs but Halin was the first to study this class of graphs in full generality.{{sfnp|Halin|1971}}

==Life==
Halin was born on February 3, 1934, in [[Uerdingen]].<ref name="dates">{{citation|last=Diestel|first=Reinhard|title=Rudolf Halin 1934–2014|date=December 7, 2014|url=http://dmatheorynet.blogspot.com/2014/12/dmanet-rudolf-halin-1934-2014.html|series=DMANET mailing list|author-link=Reinhard Diestel}}. Date corrected in a follow-up email from Diestel. Birthplace from his books ''Graphentheorie I, II''.</ref>
He earned his doctorate from the [[University of Cologne]] in 1962, under the supervision of [[Klaus Wagner]] and Karl Dörge, after which he joined the faculty of the [[University of Hamburg]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=19960}}</ref>
He died on November 14, 2014, in [[Mölln, Schleswig-Holstein]].<ref name=dates/>

==Recognition==
In February 1994, a colloquium was held at the University of Hamburg in honor of Halin's 60th birthday.<ref>[http://www.forschungsbericht.uni-hamburg.de/Forber8/aforber/e11/e11010/b11010.htm Mathematisches Seminar], Univ. of Hamburg, retrieved 2013-02-19.</ref>
In 2017, a special issue of the journal ''Abhandlungen aus dem Mathematischen Seminar der Universität Hamburg'' was published in his memory.<ref>{{citation|last=Diestel|first=Reinhard|title=Rudolf Halin: 1934–2014|journal=Abhandlungen aus dem Mathematischen Seminar der Universität Hamburg|volume=87|issue=2|pages=197–202|year=2017|doi=10.1007/s12188-016-0161-2|mr=3696145|author-link=Reinhard Diestel|doi-access=free}}</ref>
